title: Upload recording
heading: Upload a recording
intro: Choose the audio or video of your meeting and Sauri takes care of the rest.
dropHint: or choose it from your computer
transferHelp: Don't close this tab until it finishes. When it reaches 100%, we'll open the meeting and you'll see how processing is going.
awaitingConfirmation: File sent. Waiting for the server to confirm; processing may still be pending.

errors.unauthenticated: No active session. Log in to upload the recording.
errors.http: Couldn't upload the recording (HTTP {{status}}). Try the upload again.
errors.invalidResponse: The server didn't confirm the upload. Try again with the same file.
errors.network: Network error while uploading the recording. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The upload timed out. Try the upload again.
errors.aborted: The upload was interrupted. Try the upload again.
errors.failed: Couldn't upload the recording. Try the upload again.
errors.invalidDuration: Couldn't read the recording's duration. Choose another audio or video file.
errors.unreadableRecording: Couldn't read the recording. Choose another supported audio or video file.
